data.exact_reserve_text: During 2022 we saw an increase of claims incurred due to the impact of the war in Ukraine across all underwriting years. This is current held primarily in IBNR. Other losses for which the Syndicate had large exposure during the year were Hurricane Ian. Majority of this increase is attributed to the in year result which was largely driven by investment loss, offset partially by the recovery of the 2019 Year of Account ("YOA") loss from capital providers during the distribution process. The Syndicate recorded an underwriting profit before investment income of GBP 3.2m (2021: GBP 6.6m loss), mainly driven by an improvement in underwriting performance on the 2021 YOA which contributed GBP 14.0m to the underwriting result.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims reserves at 1 January 2022 were GBP 418.211m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 30.5m (about 7.3% of opening reserves), driven principally by deterioration on older underwriting years (notably a large strengthening in the 2020 column) partially offset by modest favourable development on earlier years. The report attributes reserve movement drivers to geopolitical events (War in Ukraine) which increased IBNR, exposure to Hurricane Ian (natural catastrophe), and movements associated with reinsurance and RITC items; the 2019 YOA saw a recovery from capital providers and the 2021 YOA produced a favourable contribution of GBP 14.0m.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (liabilities) 2021 comparative column. Prior-year development computed from the GROSS claims development triangle (see technical provisions note). A Reinsurance-to-Close (RITC) impact is disclosed in the claims movements which can distort triangle-based PYD calculations; no explicit standalone gross 'movement in prior year's provision' note was found. Where the report quotes prior-year improvement (e.g. 2021 YOA GBP 14.0m) these figures appear in the narrative and have been used as supporting context but the primary PYD number above is derived from the gross triangle. Lob-level prior-year movements are not separately disclosed, so no per-LOB PYD amounts are provided.
